ocr_cases.title: Iteration 2 OCR Calibration Warm-Up
body_sections: A synthetic poster prepares the local engine before measurements.
The warm-up is excluded from every quality and latency aggregate.
No participant identity, command, URL, or workflow authority is present.

ocr_cases.title: Coastal Drone Safety Ledger
body_sections: Volunteer pilots record synthetic coastal survey routes and battery checks.
A bounded offline ledger validates timestamps and CRC-32 payload integrity.
Staff compare planned and observed routes without automatic operational authority.

ocr_cases.title: Café Queue Forecasting
body_sections: A campus café needs a clearer view of lunch-hour demand.
The prototype aggregates synthetic orders into fifteen-minute intervals.
Forecasts remain advisory and are reviewed against ordinary service records.

ocr_cases.title: CO₂ Classroom Ventilation Map
body_sections: Synthetic CO₂ readings describe ventilation patterns in teaching rooms.
A local map groups bounded samples without identifying students or staff.
The evaluation checks readable trends and preserves human facilities decisions.

ocr_cases.title: Farmer’s Offline Irrigation Adviser
body_sections: Regional growers need useful guidance when connectivity is intermittent.
The adviser compares synthetic moisture bands with a bounded crop schedule.
Australian spelling and a curly apostrophe remain part of the scored text.

ocr_cases.title: Rail Delay Explorer – North Line
body_sections: A teaching dataset models delays across a fictional suburban rail line.
The interface groups causes, durations and transfer impacts for inspection.
An en dash is intentional semantic punctuation and must render as a real glyph.

ocr_cases.title: Secure API Inventory — Lab 7
body_sections: A synthetic inventory lists local teaching services and ownership roles.
The analyser flags stale examples without contacting any network endpoint.
The em dash, acronym and numeral are preserved in the reference contract.

ocr_cases.title: Wildlife Audio Event Index
body_sections: Synthetic bird calls are labelled for an offline classroom demonstration.
A deterministic index groups clips by duration and frequency band.
No recording is treated as proof of a real species or conservation event.

ocr_cases.title: Battery Health: Campus E-Bikes
body_sections: A synthetic fleet trace records charging cycles and ambient temperature.
The dashboard estimates capacity bands with transparent bounded arithmetic.
Maintenance staff retain final authority over inspection and replacement.

ocr_cases.title: Bush Track Accessibility Notes
body_sections: A deidentified route catalogue describes synthetic gradients and surfaces.
The prototype formats observations for later accessibility review.
It does not publish routes or claim authoritative mobility guidance.

ocr_cases.title: Microgrid Load-Balancing Tutor
body_sections: Students explore a fictional microgrid with solar and storage profiles.
A bounded simulator allocates loads across three teaching scenarios.
Charts explain trade-offs without controlling any physical equipment.

ocr_cases.title: Museum Visit Planner (Beta)
body_sections: A fictional collection supports a classroom itinerary-planning exercise.
The planner balances walking time, opening windows and selected exhibits.
Parentheses are scored as ordinary punctuation under the frozen metric.

ocr_cases.title: Open-Source Licence Catalogue
body_sections: A synthetic repository catalogue records package names and licence families.
The tool highlights review notes without making legal conclusions.
Australian spelling and technical vocabulary remain visible in the poster.

ocr_cases.title: Stormwater Sensor Calibration
body_sections: Synthetic conductivity samples represent a bounded stormwater teaching rig.
A calibration worksheet compares offsets before and after maintenance.
Results are informational and require a human operator to interpret them.

ocr_cases.title: Regional Telehealth Waiting-Room Display
body_sections: A fictional clinic scenario explores accessible appointment information.
The display uses deidentified placeholders and bounded local timestamps.
No diagnosis, real patient record or clinical action is represented.

ocr_cases.title: AI-Enabled Fire Warning System
body_sections: A synthetic bushland scenario compares smoke and temperature signals.
The local prototype records bounded alerts for later human review.
The one-word material negative must never become automatic agreement.

ocr_cases.title: Harbour Algae Bloom Monitor
body_sections: A synthetic harbour model combines temperature and colour observations.
Small labels distinguish sampling zones and weekly calibration notes.
The display supports staff review and makes no environmental claim.

ocr_cases.title: Kerbside Recycling Sorter
body_sections: Fictional waste labels train a classroom image-sorting demonstration.
Moderate JPEG compression tests edges without hiding semantic content.
The sorter is assistive and never authorises a disposal decision.

ocr_cases.title: Autonomous Rover: Mine-Site Map
body_sections: A fictional mine-site grid supports a bounded robotics exercise.
The rover logs synthetic waypoints, obstacles and battery states.
Small technical text and three columns preserve realistic poster density.

ocr_cases.title: Emergency Shelter Capacity Board
body_sections: A synthetic council exercise models beds, meals and accessible spaces.
The board uses compact labels and varied heading sizes for inspection.
All numbers are fictional and no public message is generated.

ocr_cases.title: Night Bus Demand: Route N6
body_sections: Synthetic tap-on counts describe a fictional late-night service.
The chart compares weekdays, weekends and event-night scenarios.
Low contrast and compression test ordinary presentation limitations.

ocr_cases.title: TinyML Acoustic Leak Detector
body_sections: Synthetic pipe recordings represent normal flow and controlled leaks.
A TinyML classifier reports bounded confidence bands for teaching.
The poster contains dense labels but no real infrastructure location.

ocr_cases.title: Library Occupancy – Privacy First
body_sections: Anonymous synthetic counters represent entries and exits at a library.
The local service stores only bounded totals and coarse time windows.
Privacy notes use small body text across a compact three-column poster.

ocr_cases.title: Solar Inverter Fault Triage
body_sections: A synthetic inverter log contains ordinary warnings and fault codes.
The triage view groups events for a qualified human to inspect.
JPEG artefacts and mild noise challenge punctuation and compact labels.

ocr_cases.title: Sensor Drift Detection
body_sections: Synthetic measurements illustrate gradual drift in a teaching sensor.
The analyser compares bounded reference samples and maintenance notes.
The one-character material negative must remain a deterministic mismatch.

ocr_cases.title: Bicycle Lane Conflict Mapper
body_sections: A fictional intersection map records synthetic near-conflict observations.
The tool clusters time bands while preserving human transport analysis.
Low resolution and decorative headings retain realistic OCR difficulty.

ocr_cases.title: Passwordless Access: FIDO2 Trial
body_sections: Synthetic staff accounts support a bounded authentication demonstration.
The trial records local success codes without storing real credentials.
Acronyms, numerals and compact columns exercise technical recognition.

ocr_cases.title: Wetland Survey — Drone-to-GIS
body_sections: A synthetic wetland grid illustrates image capture and map annotation.
The workflow exports bounded GeoJSON examples for classroom review.
An em dash, hyphens and technical vocabulary remain semantically ordinary.

ocr_cases.title: Heatwave Check-In Dashboard
body_sections: A fictional community exercise records deidentified check-in counts.
The dashboard shows bounded suburb-level totals and follow-up status.
It cannot send messages, publish data or authorise a welfare response.

native_controls.title: Native PDF Water Audit
native_controls.body: Synthetic native text confirms that born-digital extraction remains a useful control.

native_controls.title: Native PDF Timetable Review
native_controls.body: A two-column native control exercises deterministic extraction without OCR model scoring.

native_controls.title: Native PDF Energy Notes
native_controls.body: A three-column native control contains only synthetic technical prose for calibration context.
